items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: I know about them, but I don't know about the other wines, you know.

ctx.x: You ever drink Morgan Davis? Yeah, I had that too. I like that. I like that chat, Morgan Davis. Oh yeah. The doctor put me on wine one time, Mamma Sherry. Oh yeah. I know about them, but I don't know about the other wines, you know. Because I was around to Jewish people all the time. Some of my best friends are rabbis, you know. Oh yeah? So they would teach me a few words even though I wasn't brought up in that faith. Yeah, I know. Now this old man, this old lady's husband, he was Connaker. Boy he could tell…
